::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** July 12th 1877  
**From:** Elderfield, Otterbourne, Winchester.  
**Manuscript:** MS British Library Add MSS 54921: 22-23
:::

Dear [Mr Craik](people/person_379.qmd)

Many thanks for your letter, I send the [agreement](organizations/other_160.qmd), with which I am quite satisfied. I also send by train four nos of the [Christian Remembrancer](organizations/other_59.qmd) containing four  papers

[Folk Lore & Old Stories](cmy_books/cmybook_1867.qmd)

[Lord Seaton & his Regiment](cmy_books/cmybook_66.qmd)

[The La Ferronays family](cmy_books/cmybook_64.qmd)

[Eugenie de Guérin](cmy_books/cmybook_50.qmd)

There are also- only I have not disinterred them [Miss Sewell’s Principles of Education](cmy_books/cmybook_302.qmd) and the [Life of Bishop Mackenzie](cmy_books/cmybook_52.qmd) but  these will be enough for you to see whether they are available.[^1]  

The Ghosts as you see are in Folk Lore. If advisable I could expand that a good deal - and make a little volume of it.

I have not signed the agreement as I should like you to fill it up first lest I should do it incorrectly

Yours truly
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: CMY wanted Macmillans to publish a volume of her unpublished non-fiction articles, but the idea never came to anything.
